**Charlson Score ≥ 3** is a defined comorbidity cohort used within the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] to identify patients with a high level of registered comorbidity [^src1]. It serves as the specific patient selection criterion for a supplementary quality indicator (supplementary indicator to indicator 9c) that tracks 30-day mortality following acute surgery [^src1]. 

Methodologically, the diagnoses used to calculate this score are retrieved using a 10-year lookback period [^src1]. This metric is a central component of the database's broader quality measurement framework—which evaluates acute surgery patients treated between September 1, 2022, and August 31, 2023—enabling regional and local benchmarking of mortality rates among highly comorbid individuals across Denmark [^src1].
